title: An AI Made a 3D Shooter in One File
concept: Build-log/code-lab: terminal shock, file-size reveal, no-assets teardown, code-generates-everything diagram, cost/payoff.

visual_identity.style: Code-lab dark mode terminal aesthetic with crisp neon cyan accents, raw monospace typography, and clean high-contrast card layouts.

storytelling_approach: Rapid documentary-style pacing taking the viewer from the impossible headline directly into the technical architecture breakdown, ending with the cost and implications.
hook_visual: A raw terminal window abruptly executing a browser-based 3D FPS render with zero external assets.
escalation: Rapid reveal of the 1.4 MB file size, stripping away textures, models, and audio to show pure algorithmic generation.
payoff: The final cost reveal ($550 API compute) and what it means for indie game development.

asset_requirements.subject: Claude Fable logo / Anthropic branding mark
Saltline browser game screenshot showing rainy harbor 3D low-poly graphics

constraints: No camera moves, zooms, or pans
Real facts and figures only ($550, 1.4MB, 8 hours)

motion_direction.staging_notes: All critical UI elements centered within the safe vertical middle 80% zone.

audio_direction.music_direction: Subtle low-frequency ambient drone with crisp digital clicks and rhythmic pulse.
audio_direction.narration_protection: Duck music by 15db during voiceover peaks.
